steps: Parse and scope-check the complete failure source; check its first two declarations to obtain before.
Run typeCheckDeclaration defaultFuel on the third (mutual) declaration. Require coverage rejection.
From before, run tryCatch of that same attempted declaration with a pure recovery action.

Require after.sig == before.sig, after.warnings == before.warnings, after.provisional == before.provisional, after.terminationBudget == before.terminationBudget, and after.sealedData == before.sealedData.
Require lookups good and missing to remain absent in both committed and provisional signatures; inference of each function must fail.
Parse and scope-check the recovery source. From after, check only its mutual block and trailing let, without rechecking its duplicate setup declarations.
Require both functions marked checked, empty provisional state, and accepted use declaration.
apiScenarios.limitation: Whole-document CLI rejection alone cannot observe rollback. This scenario requires the internal TypeCheck API.
